details: With no argument, show common commands.
Paths ending in / are categories; other paths are executable commands.
depth  Maximum depth below path, or below the root when path is omitted
path   Command or category for full help
swban help/en 2                #List paths up to two levels
swban help/en check 2          #List two levels below check
swban help/en check/browser 3  #List three levels below check/browser
swban help/en check/csp        #Show full command help
不带参数时显示常用命令。
路径末尾的 / 表示分类，其余为可执行命令。
depth  从指定路径向下计算的最大层级；省略路径时从根目录计算
path   查看指定命令或分类的完整帮助
swban help/en 2                #列出一至二级命令和分类
swban help/en check 2          #列出 check 下两层命令和分类
swban help/en check/browser 3  #列出 check/browser 下三层命令和分类
swban help/en check/csp        #查看完整命令说明
